products.name: Figma
products.key_insight: Figma is the most elegant example of network-effect behavioral design in B2B software. Every design decision serves a single behavioral insight: make collaboration so effortless that the tool becomes the team's shared space, not just one designer's workspace. The cursor presence feature (seeing teammates' cursors labeled with their names in real-time) is pure social facilitation — knowing someone is watching you work changes how you work. The generous free tier isn't charity — it's a viral acquisition mechanism: every designer who opens a Figma link to view a prototype becomes a potential user. Figma's file-sharing is designed like Google Docs, not like Photoshop: no installation, no file format confusion, no version control headaches. By eliminating every friction point in collaboration, Figma made itself structurally impossible to replace — switching to a competitor means convincing your entire team, your clients, and your developer handoff workflow to switch simultaneously. This is behavioral lock-in through genuine value creation, not dark patterns.
products.top_technique: Multiplayer Cursor Presence as Social Facilitation
